---
title: "CV / Contact"
---

[Download PDF ↗](cv.pdf)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
# cv.yml을 읽어 섹션별로 '연도 | 내용' 행을 만든다. 내용 수정은 cv.yml에서.
cv <- yaml::yaml.load(
  paste(readLines("cv.yml", encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n")
)
out <- character()
for (section in names(cv)) {
  out <- c(out, paste0("\n## ", section, "\n\n"))
  for (item in cv[[section]]) {
    out <- c(out, paste0("::: {.cv-row}\n[", item$when, "]{.when}\n\n", item$what, "\n:::\n\n"))
  }
}
knitr::asis_output(enc2utf8(paste(out, collapse = "")))
```
